hotel_2star_room_2p.sourceTitle: The Best 2 Star Hotels in Budapest from $36 | Expedia
hotel_2star_room_2p.evidenceText: Expedia's 2-star Budapest trend table shows August $96. It states price-trend information excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed 2-star properties in Budapest.
hotel_2star_room_2p.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.
hotel_2star_room_2p.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Budapest Hungary 2-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
hotel_2star_room_2p.reason: Accepted as source-feasibility evidence with a known excluded-tax base-rate basis; it is not an inclusive product observation.
